description: This file defines the DragRigidbody class, which enables click-and-drag manipulation of rigidbody objects in a Unity scene using raycasting and a spring joint.

classes.name: DragRigidbody
classes.description: Unity MonoBehaviour that allows users to drag rigidbody objects with the mouse, utilizing physics spring joints for realistic interaction.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Processes mouse input to initiate dragging, performs raycast hit detection, and sets up a spring joint to move the target rigidbody.

methods.name: DragObject
methods.description: Coroutine that updates the position of the spring joint during dragging, restoring rigidbody properties afterward.

methods.name: FindCamera
methods.description: Returns the Camera component attached to this object if available, or the main camera otherwise.
